evidence: decorative_mascot: Data stands at the edge of the scale pan (hook@0.3, seg0:end), perches on top of the 10% bubble (seg1:mid), cheers on top of the podcast bar (seg2:mid) and slides beside the stacked column (seg3:mid). He never causes the tilt, the growth or the fill.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: A single stacked column labelled 'DON'T IS 65% OF THE WHOLE'. The accent blue goes on the 65% who DON'T listen, while the 35% podcast share is grey. The labels are near-invisible at seg3:start, and Data slides up beside the column doing a surprised pose.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The share relationship fell back to a stacked-column chart. The accent was given to the larger part instead of the story's subject (podcast listeners), and the mascot was placed beside the chart with no causal act.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show 35% of Americans listening weekly as a subject-made picture, for example a crowd of 100 figures where Data hands headphones to 35 of them one by one. Put the accent on the 35% podcast listeners, keep 'Don't' neutral, and make the labels high-contrast from the first frame.
